name: Blue-Green Deployment with Global Accelerator
summary: Set up a blue-green deployment strategy to minimize downtime and risks during application updates using AWS Global Accelerator.
description: This project aims to implement a blue-green deployment strategy utilizing AWS Global Accelerator to ensure seamless application updates with minimal downtime and reduced risk. The process involves creating two identical environments, 'blue' and 'green', where one serves live traffic while the other is idle. During updates, the new version of the application will be deployed to the idle environment, allowing for thorough testing before switching traffic over. This approach not only enhances system reliability but also facilitates quick rollbacks in case of issues. The project will include configuring AWS Global Accelerator to manage traffic routing effectively, ensuring optimal performance and availability. The final deliverable will be a fully operational blue-green deployment setup, complete with documentation and best practices for ongoing management.
deliverables: Setup of AWS Global Accelerator for traffic management (work)
Documentation of deployment process and best practices (document)
Consultation session for project review and Q&A (consultation)
